Title: Fassarar wasa
Subtitle: Fassara fassarar Turanci daga PS5 a cikin OBS.
ConnectHint: Ƙara rubutun zuwa wurin wasanku sau ɗaya.
TestHint: Gwada layin samfurin kafin haɗa na'urar wasan bidiyo.
SelectHint: Zana akwati a kusa da fassarar Turanci akan firam ɗin wasa.
AreaReady: Ajiye yanki subtitle. Kunna kyamarar kama-da-wane ta OBS.
Help: Zaɓi wurin wasan ku a cikin OBS. Buɗe Kayan aiki → Rubutun kuma danna +. Manna hanyar rubutun kuma buɗe fayil ɗin. Danna maballin da ke cikin saitunan rubutun don ƙara fassarar magana zuwa wurin. Koma zuwa SubZir kuma gwada fassarar.
Checking: Karatun layin samfurin da duba haɗin OBS…
TestSuccess: OBS ya karɓi layin samfurin. Duba matsayinsa a wurin.
TestNoAck: Fassarar ta yi nasara, amma OBS bai tabbatar da hakan ba. Zaɓi wurin wasan ku kuma maimaita mataki na 1.
Waiting: Ana jiran fassarar Turanci daga kyamarar kama-da-wane ta OBS…
OcrMissing: Shigar da ƙwarewar rubutu na Ingilishi a cikin Windows. Dubi jagora don umarni.
CheckCamera: Bincika kyamarar kama-da-wane kuma zaɓi yankin rubutun kuma sake.
TestFailed: Gwajin ya kasa gamawa. Buɗe Shirya matsala a cikin jagorar.
TestEmpty: Ba a karɓi layin samfurin ba. A sake gwada gwajin.
GettingFrame: Ana samun firam daga kyamarar kama-da-wane ta OBS…
NoFrame: Babu firam da aka karɓa. A cikin OBS, fara kyamarar kama-da-wane kuma maimaita mataki na 3.
LaunchError: Cire duka ZIP zuwa Takardu kuma a sake gwadawa.
Picker: Zana akwati a kusa da yankin don layi ɗaya ko biyu
GuideBody: Kunna fassarar Turanci a cikin wasanku. Haɗa katin ɗaukar hoto a cikin OBS. Ƙara rubutun subtitle zuwa wurin wasan. Saita fitowar kyamarar kama-da-wane zuwa tushen katin kama kuma fara kyamarar kama-da-wane. A cikin SubZir, zaɓi yankin subtitle kuma fara fassara.
AddScene: Ƙara subtitles zuwa yanayin halin yanzu
ModelError: Samfurin fassarar ya kasa cika buƙatar. Dubi runtime/diagnostics.txt.
